notes: A brand new Home: your total balance, accounts as swipeable cards, and the latest payments at a glance
Hide your balances with one tap when someone is looking
New Budgets & Insights: see where your money went on one colourful ring
A big + button to add anything, and quick Scan & pay, Cash, Split and Remind
Works calmly offline, warns before you lose a half-typed entry, and clearer search results
Stronger security: fake copies of the app are blocked, and the PIN lock counts down after wrong tries
Faster and smoother, with less clutter on every screen
